page.layout: Running head at top, with page number at top right. Below it, two engraved medallions side by side (portraits of Gian Galeazzo and Giovanni Maria Visconti, with legends; the legends are part of the engravings, not text). Below them one column of running text in two paragraphs, full width. No notes in the margins, no catchword, no signature.

main_text.l: IO. GALEATIVS Vicecomes, Galeatij Mariæ filius,
anno mundi 5333. à Christo nato 1371. postquam more pa-
trum suorum, annos 17. Mediolani imperauerat, à Ladislao
Cæsare, Dux Mediolani creatur. Ut autem à suis inciperet,
Barnaba patruo occiso, opes eius & imperium occupauit. Hinc
Veronam, Vicentiam, & Paduam subiugauit. ad Occidentem,
Vercellas, Albam, atque Astam subegit. ad meridiem debella-
uit Aquas, Alexandriam, Tortonam, Bubbium, Placentiam,
Parmam, Regium, Bononiam, Pisas, Massam, Senas, Grosse-
tum, atque Clusium. & reuertens Perusium, Assisium, No-
ceam, Ciuitatem, Bellonam cepit & Feltrum: &(ut velut cir-
culum absoluueret) Brixiam, Bergamum, Laudem, Cremo-
nam, atque Cremam, subegit. Lucenses in deditionem acce-
pit. tota ipsum Italia reformidauit. Ticini ædificauit arcem
superbam, ad quartum verò lapidem, septum admodum in-
gens, ad feras omnis generis asferuandas, cum cænobio ma-
gnifico extruxit. fuit pulcher, doctus, & eloquens: sed impri-
mis sagax. Tandem 55. ætatis anno, post 24. imperij obiit, re-
licta Valentina, Caroli Regis Franciæ postea uxore. Paul. Io-
uius, & Supplementum Chro.
IO. MARIA Vicecomes, adhuc paruulus, & sub ma-
terna custodia, anno Salutis 1402. felicissim. patri successit. Hic
cum adoleuisset, multos innocentes occidit, & non paucos ini-
micos canibus vivos devorandos tradidit. Piam matrem de-
trusit in carcerem, ibíque eam sæuissimè mori coegit. Verùm
mox quasi Deo vindice, nudatus amplissim. bonis paternis, à do-
mesticis, post decem annorum tyrannidem, in templo trucida-
tur. Paul. Iou. & Supplementum.

page.notes: Two engraved medallions at the top, showing profile portraits of Gian Galeazzo Visconti (left) and Giovanni Maria Visconti (right), with circular legends. The left legend reads roughly "IO. GALEATIVS" and "DVX MLI" and the right legend roughly "IOANNES" and "DVX MLI", but the letters are partly worn and only approximately read. Doubtful readings: "absoluueret" (the uu spelling is unclear), "felicissim." and "amplissim." (the abbreviation mark is uncertain, possibly meaning -issimè). A small stray slash mark appears centred below the second paragraph; it is not printed text and is not transcribed. Faint show-through of the reverse side is present and not transcribed.
